crossRefs.note: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of…
Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son.…
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which Yahweh selects…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.
translations.bsb: So Joshua arose early the next morning and had Israel come forward tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was selected.
translations.kjv: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
translations.asv: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel near by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
